messages:
Priya N: New RFI from AtlasGrid — they want capability matrix, PoC dates, redacted FIPS attestation, and detailed pricing for 500k/day for 60 days. Can we split tasks?
Owen H: I'll own the capability matrix + pricing comparison hosted vs reserved.
Catherine R: I'll do PoC runbook and coordinate attestation redaction with Security. sec-bot: redaction policy applied — remove serials/fingerprints; full attestation via secure SFTP after NDA.
rfi-bot: Please upload attachments to https://drive.redwood when ready.
Owen H: Proposed matrix columns: Feature | Supported | Deploy modes | EU residency | HSM/KMS | SLA (p95) | p95 (256 tok) | QPS | Cost notes | Attachments. I'll seed rows and attach CSV.
Catherine R: PoC plan: weekend provisioning, baseline perf, traffic replay, security checks, handover. Ops can provision 2026-05-02 08:00-12:00 UTC.
Priya N: AtlasGrid requires EU-only at rest and FIPS HSM. Mark attestation as "redacted attestation included; full attestation on request (secure channel)". Owen, include that in matrix.
Owen H: Uploaded: atlasgrid_capability_matrix_v1.csv -> https://drive.redwood/atlasgrid_capability_matrix_v1.csv. Draft pricing attached: atlasgrid_pricing_draft.csv.
Catherine R: Uploaded: atlasgrid_poc_runbook_v1.md and atlasgrid_kms_flow_redacted.png. Legal looped for NDA text.
Priya N: Target send date 2026-05-07 COB. Once attachments are final, Jorge (sales) will send. Thanks all. :rocket:
